description: This source file defines an object `TvWebViewHelper` that provides a custom `WebViewClient` for TV. The client manages URL loading policies to keep navigation within local assets, maintains DPAD focus after page load, and prevents external navigation (e.g., to external web pages).

classes.name: TvWebViewHelper
classes.description: An object providing a method to attach a custom WebViewClient for handling URL loading and focus management on TV.

methods.name: attachDefaultClient
methods.description: Attaches a custom WebViewClient to the given WebView, handling URL policies and focus after page load.

methods.name: shouldOverrideUrlLoading
methods.description: Overridden method to determine whether to override URL loading, blocking external URLs unless local.

methods.name: handleUrl
methods.description: Custom method to decide if a URL (Uri) should be loaded inside the WebView or blocked.

methods.name: onPageStarted
methods.description: Called when a page starts loading (default implementation in this context).

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Called when a page finishes loading; sets focus to the WebView to preserve DPAD navigation.
